headline: Tokyo,
today.
scenes.narration: Maja's flying to Tokyo today. FlyRight has been counting down since breakfast.

headline: She knows
before she's there.
scenes.narration: Terminal two, check-in area two, gate fifty-two. She knows before she gets there.

headline: Each step,
as she goes.
scenes.narration: She taps each step as she goes, and Clara, Noah and Tomas see it as it happens.

headline: One tap.
Her pass.
scenes.narration: At the gate, or in duty free, her boarding pass is one tap away.

headline: Walking
to her row.
scenes.narration: Walking to her row, she checks the seat. Twenty-four A.

headline: Now it counts
down to landing.
scenes.narration: In the air, the card keeps counting — down to landing now.

headline: Her plane,
on its line.
scenes.narration: And on the World tab, her plane rides its own line across a globe FlyRight drew itself.

headline: A postcard
to her people.
scenes.narration: Somewhere over Siberia, she writes a postcard to her people.

headline: Where it
lands.
scenes.narration: It lands in Updates, next to Tomas, just home, and Clara, still in the air.

headline: Tap one.
Follow it.
scenes.narration: Tap one, and you follow their whole day.

headline: Belt twelve,
before the sign.
scenes.narration: Bags on belt twelve, before the airport sign says so.

headline: Free to keep.
Pro to travel.
scenes.narration: Keeping flights and following people is free. Pro is the live day: gate, delay, belt, and postcards.

headline: Her followers
see it free.
scenes.narration: Her followers see all of it free. Monthly, yearly, or lifetime, through RevenueCat.

headline: What she's
owed.
bullets: Raise the claim from the app
scenes.note: Sample delay · eligibility depends on the circumstances
scenes.narration: If it runs late, it works out what she's owed.

headline: Every trip,
a poster.
bullets: A glow where she flies most
scenes.narration: And every trip becomes a poster she can share.

headline: One place
for the whole journey.
scenes.narration: FlyRight. One place for the whole journey.
